description: Retrieve FIRST Championship regional pool points earned at a 2025+ regional event. Returns per-team qualification, alliance selection, elimination, award, and rookie bonus points with totals, plus tiebreakers. Returns null for district events and pre-2025 events; for those use get_event_district_points or get_event_advancement_points. For season-long standings see get_regional_rankings.

event_key.description: TBA event key combining the season year and event code (e.g., '2023casj' for the 2023 Silicon Valley Regional, '2024txhou' for the 2024 Houston Championship, '2024micmp4' for a Michigan State Championship division). Use get_events or get_events_keys to discover valid event keys for a year.

name: get_event_regional_champs_pool_points
title: Get Event Regional Pool Points
